_about: The 11 libraries reviewed in round 1 (7 Oct 2026): licence, size, role in the catalogue, verdict. Item rows: items.jsonl / items.cat.jsonl; code facts: code-facts.jsonl.

libraries.name: Arc
libraries.verdict: The base: every free item handles reduced motion and ships when-to-use docs, an agent skill and an MCP. Install free items only; Pro is reference.

libraries.name: EasyUI
libraries.verdict: Agents: agent run, AI answer, dense table, machine log. Map colours to tokens before install.

libraries.name: Space UI
libraries.verdict: Period filter, big virtual grid, presence. Check motion before install.

libraries.name: uselayouts
libraries.verdict: The prompt box (a pill that grows into the composer).

libraries.name: Toolcraft
libraries.verdict: Tuning panels and settings export while we design.

libraries.name: Devigner
libraries.verdict: Small and careful; stepper and heat slider usable; its date range is for bookings.

libraries.name: Kinetics
libraries.verdict: No licence, so nothing is copied.

libraries.name: bencho
libraries.verdict: A gallery of links that feeds intake.
